actual_scope: Determine the exact bandwidth-uniform positive parameter range for the strict ordered-minor and Schur-fill sign criterion of the linearly truncated real Gaussian kernel. The sharp range is 0<t<=1/2, extending PR5207's sufficient 0<t<=1/3 range and excluding every larger t.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit unresolved endpoint question in PR5207, Open next question 2. The formal-interface card is changed to a written algebraic interface theorem rather than an audit or a proof-assistant formalization. The predecessor criterion is cited; only the new parameter range and sharp obstruction are claimed.
bottleneck_link: A Gaussian inverse/Schur interface side result: determine when all structural real fill is present and every principal pivot is positive. This enlarges the proven parameter range but does not bind a retained caller or move the selected supplier budget.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved endpoint improvement, its universal sharpness obstruction and bounded exact corroboration. No larger-band threshold search or caller integration.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the all-size argument. The standalone verifier checks the new range t=2/5,9/20,1/2: 503 strict polynomial evaluations and one exceptional zero; 75 finite alternating tails; 8307 ordered minors; 2223 Schur layouts and 25335 entries by rational updates and integer determinant ratios; six above-half obstructions; 511 endpoint recurrence steps; eight invalid inputs, three altered-matrix rejections and two Schur scope fixtures.

open_questions.blocked_by: An authenticated concrete caller and any complex, periodic or nonpositive phase factors.

open_questions.blocked_by: A fixed-bandwidth all-size argument; finite positive tables alone do not establish it.
